text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its main tasks is image recognition, which means identifying what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. A related skill is object detection, where a system not only names objects but also finds their exact location in an image. These technologies have many real-world applications. For example, in self-driving cars, computer vision helps detect pedestrians, traffic lights, and other vehicles, allowing the car to make safe decisions. It is also used in medical imaging, security cameras, and smartphone photo sorting, making our lives easier and safer every day.
